faqs.q: What is the minimum hourly rate for a school counsellor under the award?
faqs.a: Under the Educational Services (Schools) General Staff Award 2020, school counsellors (wellbeing services employees) are classified at various levels. For example, Level 4.1 has a minimum hourly rate of $31.11, Level 5.1 is $33.73, and Level 6.1 is $36.61. The exact classification depends on duties and experience. These rates are from the Fair Work Ombudsman's pay guide effective from 1 July 2026.

faqs.q: How is casual loading applied to a school counsellor's pay?

This loading compensates for entitlements like annual leave and sick leave that casuals do not receive. The loading is paid on all ordinary hours worked.

faqs.q: How is superannuation calculated for a school counsellor?

bodyMarkdown:
## School Counsellor Salary: A Guide to Hourly, Annual, and Fortnightly Pay

Understanding a school counsellor salary in Australia starts with knowing the correct award classification and how to convert hourly rates to annual, fortnightly, and after-tax figures. This guide uses the latest Fair Work Ombudsman rates for the Educational Services (Schools) General Staff Award 2020 and the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) median earnings data.

### Award Rates for School Counsellors

School counsellors are covered by the Educational Services (Schools) General Staff Award 2020. The award includes a classification for "wellbeing services" employees, which covers counsellors and therapists. Minimum pay rates are set by classification level. For example:

- Level 4.1: $31.11 per hour, $1,182.10 per week, $61,682 annual (based on 52.18 weeks)
- Level 5.1: $33.73 per hour, $1,281.70 per week, $66,879 annual
- Level 6.1: $36.61 per hour, $1,391.30 per week, $72,598 annual

These rates are from the Fair Work Ombudsman's pay summary and apply from the first full pay period on or after 1 July 2026.

### Converting Hourly to Annual (38-Hour Week)

The standard full-time week under the award is 38 ordinary hours. To estimate an annual salary, multiply the hourly rate by 38 hours and then by 52 weeks. For a Level 4.1 school counsellor:

$31.11 × 38 × 52 = $61,473 (rounded)

This is close to the award's official annual figure of $61,682, which uses 52.18 weeks. Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool uses 52 weeks for simplicity. The difference is minor.

### Fortnightly and Weekly Pay

Fortnightly pay is simply the weekly rate multiplied by two. For Level 4.1:

- Weekly: $1,182.10
- Fortnightly: $2,364.20

This helps when budgeting or comparing job offers. See our [pay guides](/blog) for more award breakdowns.

### Median Earnings vs Award Minimums

The ABS Survey of Employee Earnings and Hours (May 2023) reports median full-time earnings for counsellors (including school counsellors) at $1,477 per week, or $39 per hour. This is higher than the award minimum, reflecting experience and qualifications. Many school counsellors are paid above the award rate.

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

Using the 2026-27 resident tax rates (nil up to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above) and the 2% Medicare levy, a school counsellor earning $61,473 would pay:

- Tax: $8,267 (approx)
- Medicare: $1,229
- Net annual: $51,977
- Net fortnightly: $1,999

Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator for a personalised estimate. Note that HELP repayments, Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not included.

### Superannuation on Top

Employers must pay super guarantee contributions of 12% on ordinary earnings (for 2026-27). This is paid on top of the gross salary. For a $61,473 salary, super adds $7,377 per year, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. See [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for more.

### Casual Loading

Casual school counsellors receive a 25% loading on the base hourly rate. For Level 4.1, the casual rate is $38.89 per hour. This loading is included in the hourly rate you see in job ads—do not add it again. Our [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page explains how to use the timesheet checkbox correctly.

### National Minimum Wage Comparison

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. A school counsellor at Level 4.1 earns $31.11, which is 18% above the minimum. See [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) for details.

### Summary

A school counsellor salary under the award ranges from about $61,500 to $72,600 per year for full-time work, depending on classification. Median earnings are higher at around $77,000 ($39/hr). Use our [the timesheet](/) to convert your hourly rate to annual, fortnightly, and after-tax figures. Always check the specific award classification with your employer.
